L // This header file defines a `Mutex` -- a mutually exclusive lock -- and the
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 77 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // most common type of synchronization primitive for facilitating locks on
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 74 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // shared resources. A mutex is used to prevent multiple threads from accessing
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 79 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // and/or writing to a shared resource concurrently.
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 52 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
L // Unlike a `std::mutex`, the Abseil `Mutex` provides the following additional
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 78 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // features:
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 12 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //   * Conditional predicates intrinsic to the `Mutex` object
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 61 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //   * Shared/reader locks, in addition to standard exclusive/writer locks
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 74 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //   * Deadlock detection and debug support.
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 44 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
L // The following helper classes are also defined within this file:
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 66 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
L //  MutexLock - An RAII wrapper to acquire and release a `Mutex` for exclusive/
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 79 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //              write access within the current scope.
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 54 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
L //  ReaderMutexLock
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 19 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //            - An RAII wrapper to acquire and release a `Mutex` for shared/read
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //              access within the current scope.
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 48 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
L //  WriterMutexLock
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 19 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //            - Effectively an alias for `MutexLock` above, designed for use in
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 79 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //              distinguishing reader and writer locks within code.
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 67 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
L // In addition to simple mutex locks, this file also defines ways to perform
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 76 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // locking under certain conditions.
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 36 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp

T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 72 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp

T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 73 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp

T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 67 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp

T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp

T 41 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
